text:
Senior code review completed and written to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-105249-feature-new-pages/review.json` (`verdict: "needs_changes"`).

### Passing checks
- **Correctness & Data Model (`FR-1`..`FR-20`)**: Multi-page model (`ExcalidrawPage`, optional `element.pageId`), active-page scene filtering vs. full-document access, per-page viewports, page-scoped undo/redo stacks, `PageBar` UI (`UIOptions.canvasActions.pages`), cross-page search, serialization/restore, single-page visual export, `#json=` share links, and collaboration/Firebase reconciliation match `requirements.md` and `change_plan.md`.
- **Type safety & Lint (`NFR-2`)**: `yarn test:typecheck` and `yarn test:code` pass with 0 errors/warnings.
- **Role / Mode Gating & Encryption (`NFR-4`)**: `PageBar` allows tab switching in `viewModeEnabled` while hiding create/rename/reorder/delete controls; Firebase and WebSocket collaboration encrypt page metadata with AES-GCM.

### Finding
- **[blocker]** `packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx:611` — `exportToClipboard({ type: "json", ... })` calls `clipboardModule.copyToClipboard`, which calls `copyTextToSystemClipboard` within the same module (`clipboard.ts`), bypassing `vi.spyOn(clipboardModule, "copyTextToSystemClipboard")` and failing in jsdom. Fix by spying on `vi.spyOn(clipboardModule, "copyToClipboard").mockResolvedValue()` and asserting on `copySpy.mock.lastCall![0]`.
